meta.title: vukem-finances: open-source personal finance you host
meta.description: Track accounts, budgets and spending with an open-source app you run yourself, on Docker or on your desktop. Your data stays yours.
meta.ogAlt: vukem-finances, open-source personal finance you host yourself

hero.title: Your money, in an app you own
hero.lead: vukem-finances records accounts, transactions and budgets, shows where the month went, and runs on your own computer or server. No account with us, no one else holding your numbers.
hero.note: Self-hosted software: you run it, so there is no hosted service.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Start it with Docker on your machine or a VPS, or open the desktop app for Windows, macOS or Linux.

steps.title: Record
steps.text: Add transactions by hand, send a short message to the Telegram bot, or import a CSV or OFX statement.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: Read the dashboard and the reports, set monthly budgets and goals, and export everything whenever you want.

items.title: Quick entry
items.text: Add a transaction in a few keystrokes, with keyboard shortcuts and a command palette.

items.title: Import statements
items.text: Bring in CSV and OFX files from your bank.

items.title: Recurring and installments
items.text: Schedule repeating entries and split a purchase across months.

items.title: Telegram bot
items.text: Link a private chat and record an expense with one short message. The bot is off until you configure it.

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: See balances, income and spending for the month at a glance.

items.title: Reports
items.text: Cash flow, breakdowns by category, account and tag, net worth over time and period comparison.

items.title: Search and filters
items.text: Find any transaction by text, date, category, account, tag or amount.

items.title: Budgets
items.text: Set a monthly limit per category and watch it fill.

items.title: Goals and alerts
items.text: Save toward a target and get notified when something needs attention.

items.title: Credit cards
items.text: Track card statements and what you owe, apart from your everyday accounts.

items.title: Export anything
items.text: Download your transactions as CSV or your whole workspace as JSON at any time.

items.title: Families and roles
items.text: Invite people to a shared workspace as owner, admin, member or viewer.

items.title: AI with your own key
items.text: Optional categorization and questions about your spending, using a key you provide. Off by default, and personal details are removed before anything is sent.

items.title: In the browser
items.text: The web app works in any modern browser, in light and dark themes, in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

items.title: On the desktop
items.text: A native app for Windows, macOS and Linux that works offline and keeps data in your user folder.

items.title: From the terminal and code
items.text: A command line and a REST API with scoped tokens, built on the same operations as the app.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.lead: The software runs where you put it. There is no vukem-finances server in the middle.
points: The default database is SQLite, a file on your own disk.
This website sets no cookies, runs no analytics and loads nothing from other sites.
AI features are off until you add your own key, and only redacted text is sent to the provider you chose.
The Telegram bot is optional. Messages pass through Telegram's servers, which are not end-to-end encrypted.
The source is public under the MIT license, so you can read exactly what it does.

editions.title: Two editions, one program
editions.lead: The same binary runs in two editions, chosen when you start it.

personal.title: Personal
personal.text: For one person or one family on their own computer or server. One workspace, registration closed, no plan limits and every feature on.

saas.title: SaaS
saas.text: For an operator who runs it for several people on their own server. It ships with billing, workspaces and plan limits for whoever hosts it.

editions.notice: vukem-finances does not currently offer a hosted service. The plans below describe what the SaaS edition allows when you run it yourself.

install.title: Get it running
install.lead: Pick the way that suits you. Everything is a plain link to the documentation or the repository.
install.dockerText: Published on GitHub Container Registry and Docker Hub:
install.desktopText: Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux are attached to each release on GitHub. The builds are not code-signed, so your system may show a warning the first time you open them.

items.q: Is there a hosted version I can use?
items.a: No. vukem-finances is software you run yourself, on your computer, a server or the desktop app. There is no hosted service today.
The software is free and open source under the MIT license. Free and Pro are plans of the SaaS edition for people who host it for others.
In a SQLite database on the machine that runs it. You can export it as CSV or JSON whenever you like.
The desktop app does: it runs on your own machine and keeps its data in your user folder. The web app needs a reachable server, which can be your own computer.
Yes. A workspace can have several people with the roles owner, admin, member and viewer, added by invitation.
No. The builds are unsigned, so Windows or macOS may warn you before the first launch.
Only if you turn it on and give it your own key. It is off by default.
